**In one line**: Hackers with a track record of breaching OpenAI's systems have reportedly warned that AI companies are not taking security seriously enough.

### Key points
- The report says hackers who broke into OpenAI flagged weak security readiness across AI firms.
- The warning frames the fast-moving AI industry as prioritizing development speed over security.
- Details such as the intrusion methods and scope of impact are not confirmed here — see the original report.

### Why it matters
AI companies hold high-value assets: model weights, training data, and user information. A warning from people who have been inside those systems suggests the industry may need to treat security as seriously as it treats shipping speed.
